test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of this sentence:

(A) the country

(B) was devastated

(C) by a powerful cyclone

(D) last month
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1) ABCD.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence should start with the subject, followed by the verb, the object, and the time expression. 
 
• "The country" (A) is the subject, followed by the verb "was devastated" (B).
 
• "By a powerful cyclone" (C) is the prepositional phrase explaining what caused the devastation, and "last month" (D) is the time expression, which logically comes at the end.
 
• The correct arrangement is "The country was devastated by a powerful cyclone last month."

Therefore, the correct answer is- ABCD.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Option 2) BACD starts with the verb, which would make the sentence less natural.

Option 3) ABDC disrupts the logical order of the sentence elements.

Option 4) ACBD places the time expression too early, confusing the structure.
